input.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
input.descriptionText:
About the role
You will build features across our Rails and React stack and own them in production.

Must have
- 5+ years of professional experience with Ruby on Rails
- Strong PostgreSQL skills
- Experience with AWS

Nice to have
- Experience with GraphQL
- Familiarity with Kubernetes (k8s)

What we offer
- Health benefits and a learning budget
